faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Cochin Port Authority Apprentice recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Cochin Port Authority Apprentice recruitment is 01-10-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Apprentice post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Civil Engineering to be eligible for the Apprentice post at Cochin Port Authority. This is the primary educational requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Apprentice position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Apprentice position is between 18 years and 24 years. Candidates must fall within this age bracket to be considered for the apprenticeship.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Apprentice post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies for the Apprentice post at Cochin Port Authority. These vacancies are specifically for the Civil Engineering discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online. Candidates need to register and apply through the designated apprenticeship portal.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or stipend offered to the selected apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a stipend ranging from 13,000 to 15,000/- per month. This is the remuneration provided during the apprenticeship period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Apprentice role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their academic marks, followed by certificate verification and a medical fitness examination.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates with prior work experience apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates who have already completed one year or more of training or job experience after obtaining their qualifications are not eligible to apply for this apprenticeship.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Cochin Port Authority?
faq.answer: The official website of Cochin Port Authority is https://www.cochinport.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information about the organization and its activities.
